text: A woman kneels on a glowing pentagram. She has long, flowing red hair, orange eyes, and a slender build with smooth, light-toned skin. Her face is oval with defined cheekbones. She wears a white draped gown cinched at the waist with blue fabric, accessorized with a matching choker and bracelets. One hand rests on the floor; the other pulls her hair. The setting appears to be a dimly lit, stone-walled room with wooden furniture and mystical symbols.
